l3_edits.old: Vasya considers a coder's performance in a contest amazing in two situations: he can break either his best or his worst performance record. First, it is amazing if during the contest the coder earns strictly more points that he earned on each past contest. Second, it is amazing if during the contest the coder earns strictly less points that he earned on each past contest.
l3_edits.new: Vasya considers a coder's performance amazing only when he breaks his best performance record: during the contest, the coder earns strictly more points than he earned in every past contest.
